subject: A moody, cinematic look at how espresso is made

scenes.narrator: In the dim glow of morning, the espresso machine hisses to life like a whispered secret.
scenes.scene_overview: Set the moody, noir atmosphere of the espresso ritual

visuals.image_prompt: Dramatic close-up of a vintage chrome espresso machine with billowing steam rising, dark moody lighting, film noir aesthetic, high contrast with warm amber highlights against deep shadows
visuals.animation_prompt: Steam slowly curls upward from the espresso machine portafilter, dramatic side lighting flickers subtly

scenes.narrator: And there it is, the perfect shot, dark as midnight, crowned in liquid gold.
scenes.scene_overview: Reveal the beauty of the finished espresso with cinematic drama

visuals.image_prompt: Slow pour of rich dark espresso into a white ceramic cup, golden crema forming on the surface, dramatic shadows cast across a marble counter, cinematic film noir lighting, shallow depth of field
visuals.animation_prompt: Espresso streams down into the cup as golden crema swirls and forms on the surface, camera slowly pushes in
